title: Flaky TestSubscriberGetsANoticeOnlyWhenAPartChanges: settle() races the attach read under -race load

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S233's landing check (2026-11-25, run ork-20261125-015129-4c21, round 3) failed only in internal/daemon: TestSubscriberGetsANoticeOnlyWhenAPartChanges (internal/daemon/daemon_test.go:1148) at line 1163, "a notice for a subscription with nothing changed: {Project:alpha Parts:[items] ...}". S233 touches no internal/daemon file. The implementer could not reproduce it (go test -race -count=5 -run TestSubscriberGetsANoticeOnlyWhenAPartChanges ./internal/daemon ok; go test -race -count=1 ./... ok). Its reading: the test waits a short real-time settle() after Subscribe and then fails if any notice has arrived; under a full -race run the daemon's attach read can land after settle(), which produces the notice the test forbids. The fix should make the test wait on the attach read itself (a sync point), not on wall-clock time. Same class as the feed flake fixed by S384 (S474).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Owner decisions (2026-11-25): S544's cause is unverified and may be in the cache, not the test. Where should the fix go? -> cache ordering: in `internal/cache/cache.go`, call `onChange` before `close(f.done)`, so the notice for a read is sent before `Get` or `Snapshot` returns. The test then needs no wait. This changes production code and may affect other cache tests..
